operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case/spaced table names: "cust_order", "order_history", "order_line" must be double-quoted; column lookup case-insensitive.
All columns notnull=0 in pragma even for PKs; NOT NULL never enforced by TS, so PK/unique filtering is the only dedup.

cust_order/order_history/order_line use 'INTEGER primary key autoincrement' — sqlite assigns rowid if NULL inserted; TS inserts explicit values so fine, but autoincrement counter may collide on re-insert.
FKs declared inline as 'references customer' with NULL parent_col -> parent column = child name (customer_id, shipping_method_id, dest_address_id, order_id, status_id, book_id).
cust_order.dest_address_id -> address.address_id: parent exists but only 1000 rows vs 7550 orders; FK draw with replacement gives heavy duplication.
Composite PKs: customer_address(customer_id,address_id), book_author(book_id,author_id) — both members are also FKs; PK dedup after FK fill.
publication_date/order_date/status_date declared DATE/DATETIME but stored as TEXT ('YYYY-MM-DD' and 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'); storage class contradicts declared type.
book.publication_date samples are all 'YYYY-MM-DD' (no time); order_date/status_date include time component — Date fuzzer template will differ per column.
isbn13 stored as TEXT but all-digit strings (10-11 chars) — String fuzzer will treat as int-like and add +-1 variants.
street_number TEXT but numeric strings ('57','86') — String fuzzer int-like branch applies.
Large tables: order_history 22348, book_author 17642, book 11127 — under 300k cap, full read OK.
order_line.line_id samples start at 1024 (not 1) — autoincrement gap; PK values not contiguous.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on all INTEGER PKs/FKs: uniform in [-10^4,10^4] (scale=4 default for int family), then +-1/+-2 perturbation; produces negative and huge ids implausible for book_id/order_id.
Date fuzzer on publication_date: template %Y-%m-%d from samples; range 1800-01-01..2100-01-01 (or min/max of 5 sampled originals); fresh dates outside 1980-2022 plausible range -> FN on year filters.
Date fuzzer on order_date/status_date: template %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S; random datetimes across 300 years -> FN on 'recent orders' predicates.
String fuzzer on first_name/last_name/city/title: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings, not name-like -> FN on LIKE 'A%' or name predicates; contaminate adds junk chars.
String fuzzer on email: random strings, never '@' -> FN on email LIKE '%@%'.
String fuzzer on language_code ('eng','en-US'): random 0-20 char strings -> FN on language_code='eng'.
String fuzzer on status_value/address_status/method_name: random strings instead of the 2-6 real enum values -> FN on status_value='Delivered' etc.
Number fuzzer on num_pages: uniform [-10^4,10^4] -> negative page counts, FN on num_pages>300.
Number fuzzer on cost/price (REAL): uniform [-10^4,10^4] with +-0.01/0.02 -> negative prices, FN on price>10.

FK fill with replacement from parent's final values: customer_address.address_id drawn from 1000 addresses for 3350 rows -> duplicates, but PK(customer_id,address_id) dedup drops many rows; ties in address_id preserved (good for joins).

Small parent tables (address_status 2, shipping_method 4, order_status 6): FK draws collapse to few values -> many duplicate rows, PK dedup on order_history.history_id (fresh) keeps them; ties abundant.
book_author: book_id drawn from 11127 books, author_id from 9235 authors, PK dedup -> ~17642 rows expected but random collisions reduce; join cardinality roughly preserved.
